name: Open a new share for a member
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, look up the member by member number, and start opening a new share for them. The 'share_type' input below is only a placeholder -- the exact share type options are not known in advance, so ignore its literal text. Instead, open the share-type dropdown, read the real options it offers, and select the FIRST one listed, using its exact option text -- not a guessed product name. Enter the given initial deposit amount; if the form rejects it as below a minimum, that is a legitimate validation_rejected business outcome, not a failure. Go through the review step, read the hidden per-transaction security token off the page, then post it. Read back the confirmation reference after posting.
